experiment_data.hypothesis: Single-model item_id dominance (~58%) in G-theory decomposition is robust to item sampling — 3 independent 200-item stratified MMLU samples will show consistent item_id%, interaction percentages, and G_item (CV < 10%), ruling out that exp-001's findings are artifacts of the specific 200-item sample. Baseline comparison: Llama single-model 6-facet decomposition.

spec.command: bash scripts/run_exp001b.sh (3 samples serial, 4 GPU parallel per sample)
spec.data_path: data/mmlu_items_exp001b_sample{1,2,3}.json (3×200 items, zero overlap with exp-001 and each other)
spec.eval_data: MMLU 3×200 items (10 subjects × 20 items per sample)
